# Unavoidable inside facets at a global fixed-body concave-parameter optimum

The exact globally deepest five-rectangle example can be equipped with a
NONCONSTANT affine base weight carrying a full one-source contact martingale.
It then becomes a unique GLOBAL fixed-body parameter optimum, while both of
its minimizing caps still have inside facets. Thus global parameter
optimality plus the complete contact transport and supporting-facet zonoid
conditions does not imply inside-free cap selection.

The body is not asserted to minimize over bodies. Its depth remains far
above the OC target. This distinction is essential.

Dependencies are the exact all-normal theorem and certificate in
`candidate 79b44436a463e3c4`
and the general certificate theorem in
`candidate b2578378c7102b3c`.
For transparency, the parameter certificate and its global implication
are proved directly below; no parameter stationarity is merely assumed.

## 1. Keep the actual body and its original measure

Use the already certified n=1,d=2 body with P={-2,-1,0,1,2}, centered
rectangular fibers K_z, and

    r=(1,51/50,51/50,203/200,101/100),
    H=(4001/4000,8091/8000,403/400,8029/8000,3999/4000),
    K_z=[-r_z/2,r_z/2] times [-H_z,H_z].

Its original fiber volumes, expressed with one denominator, are

    V_z=nu_z/800000,
    nu=(1600400,1650564,1644240,1629887,1615596),
    M=8140687/800000.

Write dmu for the original mixed volume. The continuous centroid of
every fiber is0. Both r and H are concave arrays, so the actual canonical
body and complete integer projection are unchanged. All strict nonheavy
and proper closed-minor count quotas from the earlier source persist.

The target source remains Y=(0,0,0), the intended physical vertical
buffer is delta=1/4000, and the raw critical mass remains

    Q=8130713/1600000.                                  (1)

## 2. An exact positive affine tilt with the required barycenter

Define, on -1/2<a<1/2,

    F(a)=sum_z z V_z/(1+a z).

It is strictly decreasing, because

    F'(a)=-sum_z z^2 V_z/(1+a z)^2<0.

At a down to -1/2 the positive endpoint term tends to+infinity; at
a up to1/2 the negative endpoint term tends to-infinity. Thus there is
exactly one root alpha in this interval. It is positive and satisfies

    1/2000<alpha<1/1000.                                (2)

An exact algebraic specification is the unique root in (2) of

    25985788 alpha^3+52316 alpha^2-16144435 alpha+9715=0. (3)

Indeed the full rational identity is

    F(a)=(25985788 a^3+52316 a^2-16144435 a+9715)
          /[800000(a-1)(a+1)(2a-1)(2a+1)].              (4)

The denominator has no zero on the admissible interval; (2) follows
from exact opposite signs of F at its rational endpoints. Monotonicity
of F, rather than a claim about all roots of the cubic, gives uniqueness
in the positive-parameter domain.

Put t_z=1+alpha z and define

    s=exp[-sum_z(V_z/M) log t_z],
    L(z,x,y)=s(1+alpha z).                              (5)

This is positive affine on the entire actual canonical body, and
mean_mu logL=0. In particular L(Y)=s. The parameter is not constant,
since alpha>0. It has no continuous-coordinate gradient.

## 3. The actual one-source contact martingale

Define a probability law on the ACTUAL original fibers by

    d rho(z,x,y)=dmu(z,x,y)/[M(1+alpha z)].               (6)

The root equation proves its probability normalization exactly:

    sum_z V_z/(1+alpha z)
      =sum_z V_z-alpha sum_z z V_z/(1+alpha z)=M.

Its base mean is0 by F(alpha)=0. Its two continuous means are0 because
each conditional fiber remains uniform on a centered rectangle. Thus

    E_rho w=Y,       E_rho L=s=L(Y),
    (1/L(Y)) rho=dmu/(M L).                            (7)

These are precisely the full-space one-row contact martingale equations,
with source weight sigma=1. In particular the row is supported on actual
fibers; no substitute measure with an unverified continuous mean is used.
The original-volume row is especially simple:

    d bar_rho=(L/L(Y))d rho=dmu/M.                      (8)

The full ORIGINAL mixed centroid has base coordinate9715/8140687>0,
so it does not equal Y. It is the tilted row rho whose actual mean is Y. Confusing these two
means is exactly what the unsuccessful constant-weight adjustment would
have required.

## 4. Preserve the globally deepest cap geometry

Let Sigma be the same original within-fiber covariance matrix as in the
previous source. Choose the fixed invariant buffer parameter

    epsilon=delta / [sqrt(Sigma_yy)(s V_0/M)^(1/3)].      (9)

At Y the ordinary energy is V_0, so (9) gives exactly the original
physical buffer delta. Thus every cap at Y is still

    a z+t x+u y+delta sqrt(c t^2+u^2)>=0,
    c=Sigma_xx/Sigma_yy.

The already audited all-normal rational certificate applies literally,
without any change in its polynomial coefficients or normal statuses.
It proves raw depth Q and exactly the two minimizing orientations

    H_+={y-z/2>=-delta},  H_-={-y-z/2>=-delta}.          (10)

At other bases, the same pure-base caps remain strictly below Q, no
matter how L changes their physical continuous buffers. At base0, L is
identically s in the continuous coordinates. Energy is uniquely maximal
at the rectangle centroid, so the proof in the earlier source that every
other mark has depth<Q applies unchanged. Therefore Y is still the
UNIQUE globally deepest mark for this fixed body, L, and epsilon.
Its own traces are proper and its pure-base depth is strictly above Q.

## 5. Global parameter optimality and uniqueness, directly

Let U be ANY positive continuous concave full-space parameter on the same
canonical body with mean_mu logU=0. Concavity at the actual barycenter
in (7), followed by (8), gives

    U(Y)/s >= E_rho U/s = (1/M) int (U/L) dmu.

Jensen for log consequently yields

    log[U(Y)/s] >= (1/M) int log(U/L) dmu=0.            (11)

Thus U(Y)>=s=L(Y). Since energy, mass, covariance, and epsilon are fixed,
the physical buffer at the old mark Y can only increase. Its depth for
U is therefore at least Q. No competitor parameter can lower the global
maximum below Q: L is a GLOBAL fixed-body parameter optimum.

It is unique on the sampled fibers. If U(Y)>s, the fixed-mark proper-gap
strictness lemma gives depth_U(Y)>Q. For clarity, that lemma applies
because old depth Q is strictly below the pure-base depth. If the new
depth stays below pure-base depth, an attained minimizing nonvertical
cap has a proper own trace; decreasing its buffer back to the old one
strictly removes positive own-fiber volume. If it reaches pure-base
depth, strictness is immediate. Hence any other parameter attaining the
same maximum must have U(Y)=s.

Equality in (11) then forces U/L=1 original-volume almost everywhere,
by strict Jensen and the displayed concavity inequality. Continuity
upgrades this to equality on each sampled fiber, including its boundary.
Different unsampled concave extensions are not being identified.

The same argument extends to an admissible nonnegative boundary closure
that is positive on sampled interiors and has finite mean logU=0:
first replace U by U+tau L, apply the positive argument, and let tau
decrease to0. Monotone convergence after subtraction from a common upper
bound gives the logarithmic limit. The equality conclusion remains an
almost-everywhere sampled one, with the usual continuous extension if
that closure requires continuity.

## 6. Explicit supporting-facet zonoid compatibility

The example also satisfies the full normal-variation contact constraint,
not just the transport equations. Here is an explicit realization for
H_+; reflection gives H_-.

Set eta=1/200. The continuous normal is u=(0,1), of Euclidean length1.
The invariant norm derivative puts the effective source at
Y'=(0,0,-delta). On the old cap plane y-z/2+delta=0, write

    xi=(z,x,y+delta)=(z,x,z/2).

The inside face, at base -2, has xi=(-2,x,-1) with |x|<=1/2. The outside
face, at+2, has xi=(2,x,1) with |x|<=1/2+eta. The three proper sections
have their actual widths r_-1,r_0,r_1. Their linear first-moment vector is

    m=int_proper xi dx=(-eta,0,-eta/2).                 (12)

For ANY measurable inside allocation q_I(x) in [0,1], define an outside
allocation by

    q_O(x)=q_I(-x),     |x|<=1/2;
            1/4,       1/2<|x|<=1/2+eta.

The outer strips have total length2eta and zero x moment, so this gives
the exact identity

    m+int_outside q_O(x) xi dx
       =-int_inside q_I(x) xi dx.                      (13)

Thus -Z_inside is contained in m+Z_outside, with the complete universal
inside-allocation quantifier and one explicit compatible outside
allocation for each input. In particular the necessary absolute-value
zonoid inequality is satisfied. Coarea here is simply dx because the
continuous normal has unit length. The reflected cap has the identical
construction with the last component of xi and m reversed.

## 7. What the counterexample decides

Every globally minimizing cap at the unique deepest mark still has an
inside supporting facet of length1 and an outside supporting facet of
length101/100. There is no inside-free critical selection. This now holds
simultaneously with:

* actual compatibility and complete integer base;
* every strict proper closed-minor count quota and no heavy fiber;
* a positive affine full-space parameter carrying the exact contact row;
* unique global fixed-body optimality among all normalized concave weights;
* the complete supporting-facet zonoid allocation condition.

Consequently those hypotheses alone cannot rescue a facet-clearing
theorem. The remaining possible distinction is actual minimization under
BODY variations (or other hypotheses not imposed here). No such joint
minimality or Gamma payment is claimed. The original ratio remains
Q/M=8130713/16281374, well above2/9.

`../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_globally_parameter_optimal_rectangle_inside_two_sided.py` verifies
the exact algebraic root identity and isolating signs, the contact-row
mass and first-moment identities, original fiber data, and explicit
inside/outside allocation calculations. The earlier all-normal
certificate is reused unchanged. The new verifier passes1,206 exact
checks; the inherited all-normal verifier passes1,529 exact checks.
